fields.description: User-toggleable option flag (e.g. sound on/off). Toggled in FUN_08006168 then persisted by FUN_0800d700; booleanized on load in FUN_0800d8c4.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006168 flips a settings word (*DAT_08006418 == 0) and marks save dirty; FUN_0800d700 derives save byte 99 from game-state sign and FUN_0800d8c4 booleanizes byte 99 via -(u8)>>31.
fields.name: option_toggle_flag

fields.description: Config value A, range 0..100 (e.g. volume level). Low byte of the u32 at struct+100.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d700 writes it as low byte of CONCAT11 u32 at struct+100; FUN_0800d8c4 clamps it to <= 100 on load.
fields.name: setting_value_a

fields.description: Config value B, range 0..100 (e.g. volume level). High byte of the u32 at struct+100.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d700 writes it as high byte of CONCAT11 u32 at struct+100; FUN_0800d8c4 clamps (u32>>8)&0xFF to <= 100 on load.
fields.name: setting_value_b

fields.description: Bitwise complement of slot0_checksum (~sum). No sum32_inv algorithm exists in Schema v2, so it is a plain field.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d4a8 stores ~sum at struct+0x6C and FUN_0800d5ac verifies ~sum == stored word; baseline holds 0xFFFFF40B = ~0xBF4.
fields.name: slot0_checksum_complement
